paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.65% on average, with DAX strongest (+1.13%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-0.02%). Brent crude changed -1.33% to 103.33. Gold changed +0.14% to 4,222.0. Bitcoin changed +1.36% to 84,041.6406. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.244%, a relative move of +0.25%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (+3.58%) and Gold Miners (ETF) (+2.95%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: CVC planned to hush Israel defence deal to avoid controversy (FT Companies). Private equity firm made unusual decision not to announce its acquisition of a 40% stake in camouflage maker Fibrotex Deals and capital markets: JPMorgan bets on European asset management growth (FT Markets). Patrick Thomson, who heads the bank’s asset management business in Europe, said he was ‘bullish on the UK’ Central banks and macro: Will September inflation cement US interest rate policy for the rest of the year? (FT World). Market Questions is the FT’s guide to the week ahead Geopolitics and trade: Oil prices fall after Trump claims ‘energy ceasefire’ in Ukraine war (FT Companies). Announcement follows diesel deal with Putin as US president tries to contain impact of higher fuel costs ahead of election Geopolitics and trade: Trump faces Republican opposition to his diesel deal with Russia’s Putin (FT World). Lawmakers from both parties say the agreement would finance Putin’s war machine in Ukraine and violate US law
